en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street with several ornate multi‑storey buildings in historicist style. The building on the left has small turrets, circular windows and ivy climbing over an arched gateway. Adjacent façades have gabled roofs and decorative brickwork. Trees line an open square or broad sidewalk to the right. Printed cursive text appears in the bottom margin.
